title: US Monetary Policy and Central Bank Information Shocks in European Index Futures: Timing within the Announcement Window and Overnight Price Discovery
summary: Owned US futures do not supply FTSE/DAX/CAC minute paths and the source shock decomposition. Do not trade a next-open effect the abstract does not support.
about: US monetary/information shocks in European futures.
findings: Abstract distinguishes immediate European futures responses from weak next-open effects; no net strategy reproduced.
